# The Date of Album Releases and the Nancy Kerrigan Assault

## Summary

The research aims to determine which of the given albums was released closest to the date of Nancy Kerrigan's assault and which album was released closest to the date of Tonya Harding's plea deal. The albums in question are "Awake" by Dream Theater, "Inside Out" by Fates Warning, "Promised Land" by Queensryche, and "Dreamspace" by Stratovarius. The research will analyze the release dates of these albums and compare them to the dates of the assault and the plea deal. The findings will provide insight into the temporal relationship between these events and the music releases.

## Key Findings

The assault on Nancy Kerrigan occurred on January 6, 1994. According to Google, the release date of "Awake" by Dream Theater was March 20, 1994. This means that "Awake" was released 44 days after the assault. In contrast, "Inside Out" by Fates Warning was released on September 1, 1987, which is significantly earlier than the assault date. The closest album release to the assault date is "Awake" by Dream Theater, which was released 44 days after the event.
